stumbles.quote: A baseline that knows only the hit's lint category, which gives it the category's historical tic rate, scored 0.769.
stumbles.why: The 'historical' rate's source is unclear, and it may be computed from the same 261 hits. It is also unclear whether this is the category-rate figure used in the comparison.

stumbles.quote: At a 5% error budget it could settle only 24.5% of hits on its own, and the bar set in advance was 50%.
stumbles.why: 'Settle' and 'error budget' are undefined, and the pre-set bar is mentioned for the first time here. The reader doesn't know who set it. The title says 'a quarter' while the text says 24.5%, which is fine, but the basis (261 vs 300 hits) is unclear.

stumbles.quote: Jev is not joining the public posting review.
stumbles.why: The title says Jev 'stays out of review,' but the text never says what Jev would have done in review. It also doesn't say whether the category baseline's better accuracy or the unmet bar was the deciding reason.

point: Jev, a small calibrated decision model, was rejected for public posting review because it settled only 24.5% of lint hits at a 5% error budget against a 50% bar. It also barely beat a category-rate baseline, and the lint's precision varies widely by rule.
